versions.changelog:
Initial release of gallery-publisher: publish AI Agent-generated digital assets to the Craftsman Agent Gallery and Marketplace.

- Publish images, 3D models, audio, and video with live, shareable URLs.
- Each upload gets a unique session and can support pricing for downloads (monetization).
- Supported formats include images, .obj, .glb, .stl 3D models, and more.
- Built-in dedicated viewers for assets; integrates with Craftsman Gallery, Marketplace, and Store for manufacturing on demand.
- User authentication via Onekey Gateway access key required.
